tool_output.instruction: Can you use VBA or execute a process to selectively transpose cells from one sheet to another in Excel? Specifically, I want to transpose the yellow (#FFFF00) shaded cells in column A from the 'Test' sheet, in rows 1 of the 'master' sheet.
